answer_1.quote: LLM-based role-playing chatbots have been developed to simulate speakers of different personal attributes and linguistic styles so as to provide more immersive interaction with users.

answer_2.quote: we implement two metrics to assess the role-playing models. The first metric, named Simulation Score, concentrates on the fidelity of simulation, measuring the similarity between the real utterances and the agent-generated utterances for the same speaker. The second metric, named Distinction Score, measures how dissimilar the agent-generated utterances are for different roles.
